question: How does position-only holding change delay sensitivity in the existing mass-matched shallow-container geometry?
authorization: User requested existing-log mechanism analysis, then exactly 240 paired geometry executions and manuscript synchronization.
seeds: Exact extension of the original geometry cohort; no additional independent seeds. Previously observed outcomes are retained.
control: Only the initial inference_wait EEF position reference is changed to entry-measured position. Wrist references, grippers, original CAD/Target executors, geometry, mass, gains, faults and all scoring thresholds are unchanged.
physical_timing: Every original measured visual service is rounded upward to 50 ms and physically executed. No fixed-slot or asynchronous-policy experiment is added.
primary: For each executor: (position_long - registered_long) - (position_short - registered_short) on native_Y. All-fault complete time uses the same contrast.
statistics: 10000 whole-initialization-seed bootstrap resamples with seed 20261113; preserve both fault sides and every paired condition.
scope: CAD/Target geometric boundary test, not CAD/Landmark ranking transfer. Geometry and core cohorts differ in seeds.
stopping: Run the fixed 240 new formal cells once; retain every outcome. No outcome-based tuning, seed replacement, additional formal cells or model training.
